name: subagent-governance
description: Verifiable handoff and lifecycle governance for native Codex subagents

interface.shortDescription: 为 Codex 原生子 Agent 增加可验证交接与生命周期治理
interface.longDescription: Adds TaskContract v2, optional declared-context freshness checks, exact-target binding, an explicit lifecycle, and read-only diagnostics around native Codex subagents without replacing native Agent tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: 把适合并行处理的当前任务交给原生子 Agent；自动生成 TaskContract v2，确认 exact target，等待终态并完成治理收尾。
